name: PATN1 (leopard pattern)
summary: A pure modifier of the leopard complex: it pushes an LP horse toward the spotted end - one LP copy plus PATN1 gives a full-body leopard, and LP/LP plus PATN1 a nearly white fewspot. On a horse with no LP it does nothing whatever and cannot be seen, and no founder rolls it unless it already rolled LP.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: Carried, but silent on its own - it only shapes the pattern of a horse that also carries the leopard complex.
